additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

description.description: An optional description of the project.

displayName.description: A human-friendly name for the project, which can be changed.

freeformTags.description:
A simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope. It exists for cross-compatibility only.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

id.description: A unique identifier that is immutable after creation.

lifecycleDetails.description: A message describing the current state in more detail, that can provide actionable information if creation failed.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the project.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
For example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

timeCreated.description: When the project was created, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

timeUpdated.description: When the project was updated, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

ResourceLock.description:
Resource locks prevent certain APIs from being called for the resource.
A full lock prevents both updating and deleting the resource. A lock delete
prevents deleting the resource.

message.description:
A message added by the lock creator. The message typically gives an
indication of why the resource is locked.

relatedResourceId.description: The resource ID that is locking this resource. Indicates that deleting this resource removes the lock.

timeCreated.description: Indicates when the lock was created, in the format defined by RFC 3339.
